offline.scan: No network: opening an order needs the office. Wait for the network.
offline.send: No network: Send waits for the network (the DDT takes the office's number).
offline.receive: No network: you can scan the bundles; Finish receipt waits for the network.

noPermission.title: Subcontract kits are not your job here
noPermission.body: Your role does not send kits to workshops or receive their goods at this site. Ask your team leader.

mode.question: Send or receive?
mode.sendHint: Material and cut bundles to a workshop, with the DDT
mode.sendHeld: Your role does not send kits
mode.receiveHint: Bundles and leftover material back from a workshop
mode.receiveHeld: Your role does not receive goods back

pick.label: Scan the subcontract order
pick.hintSend: Its number on the job sheet, or tap an order below.
pick.hintReceive: Its number on the workshop's delivery note, or tap an order below.

emptySend.title: No kit to send
emptySend.body: No issued order of this site waits for its kit.

emptyReceive.title: Nothing out at a workshop
emptyReceive.body: No order of this site has goods at a workshop now.

kit.stateHeld: This order cannot send its kit now: the office checks it.
kit.stateShort: The office must check the order first
kit.scanHint: Each bundle's ticket, the lot or hide label, or the material's code.
kit.noStock: not in stock at this site
kit.noStockHeld: Not in stock at this site: the office sends it or changes the kit
kit.sentBefore_one: {count} bundle went out before on this order.
kit.sentBefore_other: {count} bundles went out before on this order.

nothing.title: Nothing left to send
nothing.body: Every line and bundle of this kit went out.

kit.missingBoth: Kit not complete: {bundles} bundles and {lines} materials missing.
kit.noStockLine_one: {count} material is not in stock at this site: the office sends it or changes the kit.
kit.noStockLine_other: {count} materials are not in stock at this site: the office sends them or changes the kit.
kit.noStockShort: A material is not in stock here

ddt.what: The DDT says the goods travel for work on our behalf (conto lavorazione): they stay ours at the workshop.

hint.RECIPIENT: The workshop picks it up here

ddt.appearance: What do the goods look like?

held.transport: Say who carries the goods first
held.noPdf: The DDT is not shown yet
held.reasonLine: A rejected bundle needs its reason: tap it and pick one.

back.nothing: Scan a bundle or enter material first
back.reason: A rejected bundle needs its reason

sent.done: Kit sent with DDT {number}: the goods are at {place}, still ours.

missing.title: The DDT is issued; its PDF is not stored yet
missing.body: The office prints it again from the order. The goods may go with the DDT number.

failed.title: The DDT could not be shown
failed.body: It is issued and stored: the office prints it from the order.

sent.title: DDT {number}

hint.defective: Back to us, to be reworked
hint.scrapped: The workshop says it is lost

reject.reasonsUnread: The reasons could not be read: the rejection goes without one.
reject.noReasons: No rework reasons are set: the rejection goes without one.

back.scanHint: A bundle's ticket brings its garments back; the workshop's delivery note number is kept.
back.ddtKept: Workshop's delivery note {code} kept for the receipt.

noBundles.title: No bundle went out on this order
noBundles.body: Only material went to the workshop: enter what comes back below.

back.allBackHeld: Every garment of this bundle is back

received.title: Receipt of {number} recorded
received.body: {good} good, {rejected} rejected, {scrapped} scrapped at the workshop.
received.material_one: {count} material line back into our places.
received.material_other: {count} material lines back into our places.
received.office: The office sees the receipt on the order now.

NOT_FOUND.message: No subcontract order with this number at this site.
NOT_FOUND.fix: Check the number on the job sheet or the delivery note, or ask the buyer.

NOT_SENDING.message: This order does not send a kit now.
NOT_SENDING.fix: Its state does not allow it: the buyer issues it first, or it is closed.

NOT_RECEIVING.message: Nothing of this order is at the workshop.
NOT_RECEIVING.fix: Send its kit first, or check the order number.

NOT_IN_KIT.message: This label is not in this kit.
NOT_IN_KIT.fix: Scan a bundle ticket, a lot or hide label or a material code of the list.

SENT_BEFORE.fix: Scan the next bundle of the kit.

NOT_OUT.message: This bundle did not go out on this order.
NOT_OUT.fix: Put it aside and tell the buyer.

ALL_BACK.message: Every garment of this bundle is back already.

CHANGED.fix: It was read again: check the list and send once more.

BADGE.message: This badge does not open this tablet.
